checklist.why: Label-over-control wrapper; PickerField named for choices
No when-not (optional inputs are optional rows, counts are Stepper, typed numbers are Numpad)
Root, label, control and skin named
The textarea (Note) is shown as a variant with no rule; the optional-row rule (design/optional-fields) is not reflected
Error is listed but does not render red; focus and disabled not shown
Error is a red border only, and in phone hosts not even that
Unit-in-label rule stated, but no label length or long-label example
#aeb8a1 / 11px raw in CSS; the README drift note is stale (computed #bdc7b6 / 12px)
No error-message slot, so error text cannot say what is wrong and how to fix it
The 375 render shows the error state without its red border, and the textarea in monospace

variants.name: text input
findings: Dose and Unit sit side by side in two columns; the record-sheet law says fields never go in columns

variants.name: note (textarea)
findings: The textarea renders in the browser monospace (no font-family on .field textarea)
The resize:vertical drag handle is a trap for gloved hands
edit-finding shows an always-open "Note · optional" textarea, while record-health and treatment use an "Add note" optional row: two rules for the same optional note
pig-profile.note says it three times: sheet title "Add a note", label "Note", placeholder "Add a note"

findings.text: The error state is invisible in every phone host: `:is(.farrowing-phone,.inspection-phone) :is(input...,textarea){border-color:#bdc7b6}` outranks `.field.error input{border-color:var(--red)}`. The error field computes to rgb(189,199,182).
findings.fix: Raise the error rule to `:is(.farrowing-phone,.inspection-phone) .field.error :is(input,textarea)`, or wrap the phone border rule in `:where()`. Add aria-invalid and a message line so the error is not colour only.

findings.text: The textarea renders in monospace (pen note, preview Note) because .field textarea sets no font.
The optional note is drawn two ways: an always-open "Note · optional" textarea (edit-finding, farrowing fault resolution) and an "Add note" optional row (record-health, treatment).
findings.fix: State the rule in the README: a Field is never shown open for an optional input. An optional Note is an optional row (design/optional-fields) that opens this Field. Convert edit-finding and the fault resolution note to that row.

findings.text: Inputs are 46px tall, below the 48px glove floor.
There is no slot for an error or help message, so error text cannot persist or explain the fix.
findings.fix: Add an optional hint/error line under the control, linked with aria-describedby.

findings.text: resize:vertical gives a drag-only handle; Dose and Unit sit in two columns on treatment.
findings.fix: Use auto-grow (field-sizing:content) with resize:none. Stack Dose then Unit, or put the unit in the label as the README says.
